content.short: ERC-20 Verifier analyzes smart contracts to confirm compliance with the ERC-20 format.
content.description: ERC-20 Verifier is a tooling utility designed to confirm the underlying structure of any smart contract verified on Etherscan. Users can scan a set of known contracts to confirm they are verified, providing confidence in their status and integrity. For developers, it offers an overview of the contract's underlying logic and composition, showing how the pieces fit together without revealing how individual functions execute or interoperate at runtime. The emphasis remains on structural verification rather than execution details.
content.meta: ERC-20 Verifier is an OpenZeppelin tool that checks verified contracts on Etherscan. Discover ERC-20 Verifier and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
